Package kr.dogfoot.hwplib.org.apache.poi.poifs.filesystem

Class POIFSDocument

java.lang.Object
kr.dogfoot.hwplib.org.apache.poi.poifs.filesystem.POIFSDocument
All Implemented Interfaces:
POIFSViewable, BATManaged, BlockWritable
public final class POIFSDocument extends Object implements BATManaged, BlockWritable, POIFSViewable
This class manages a document in the POIFS filesystem.
Author:
Marc Johnson (mjohnson at apache dot org)
